mapper.select: /* SQL ID : MarkSubjectDAO.stdMrkSbjctDtlSelect 설 명 : 학생 정보와 성적 상세정보 조회 */ WITH SCORE_INFO AS ( SELECT MRK.SBJCT_ID , MRK.USER_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'MIDEXAM' THEN ACQS_SCR END) AS MIDEXAM_ACQS_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'MIDEXAM' THEN DRVTN_SCR END) AS MIDEXAM_DRVTN_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'LSTEXAM' THEN ACQS_SCR END) AS LSTEXAM_ACQS_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'LSTEXAM' THEN DRVTN_SCR END) AS LSTEXAM_DRVTN_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'ATNDC' THEN ACQS_SCR END) AS ATND_ACQS_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'ATNDC' THEN DRVTN_SCR END) AS ATND_DRVTN_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'ASMT' THEN ACQS_SCR END) AS ASMT_ACQS_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'ASMT' THEN DRVTN_SCR END) AS ASMT_DRVTN_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'DSCS' THEN ACQS_SCR END) AS DSCS_ACQS_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'DSCS' THEN DRVTN_SCR END) AS DSCS_DRVTN_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' THEN ACQS_SCR END) AS QUIZ_ACQS_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' THEN DRVTN_SCR END) AS QUIZ_DRVTN_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'SRVY' THEN ACQS_SCR END) AS SRVY_ACQS_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'SRVY' THEN DRVTN_SCR END) AS SRVY_DRVTN_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'SMNR' THEN ACQS_SCR END) AS SMNR_ACQS_SCR , MAX(CASE WHEN DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'SMNR' THEN DRVTN_SCR END) AS SMNR_DRVTN_SCR , SUM(DTL.ACQS_SCR ) AS TOT_ACQS_SCR , MRK.TOT_SCR , MRK.ADTN_SCR , MRK.ETC_SCR , MRK.LST_SCR , MRK.PROF_MEMO FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK MRK JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK_DTL DTL ON MRK.SBJCT_MRK_ID = DTL.SBJCT_MRK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND MRK.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND MRK.USER_ID = #{userId} AND DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD IN ( SELECT MRK_ITM_TYCD FROM TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG X WHERE X.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID ) GROUP BY MRK.SBJCT_ID , MRK.USER_ID, MRK.TOT_SCR, MRK.ADTN_SCR, MRK.ETC_SCR, MRK.LST_SCR, MRK.LST_SCR, MRK.PROF_MEMO ) SELECT (SELECT SBJCTNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT X WHERE SCR.SBJCT_ID = X.SBJCT_ID) AS SBJCTNM , USR.USER_RPRS_ID , USR.STDNT_NO , USR.USERNM , SCR.* FROM TB_LMS_USER USR JOIN SCORE_INFO SCR ON USR.USER_ID = SCR.USER_ID

/* SQL ID: stdMrkListCntSelect 설 명 : 학생 성적 목록 수를 가져온다. */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC STD JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK A ON STD.USER_ID = A.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK_DTL B ON (A.SBJCT_MRK_ID = A.SBJCT_MRK_ID) JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG C ON (A.SBJCT_ID = C.SBJCT_ID AND B.MRK_ITM_TYCD = C.MRK_ITM_TYCD) JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON (STD.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND STD.ATNDLC_CNCL_DTTM IS NOT NULL AND STD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND STD.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} GROUP BY A.USER_ID, C.SBJCT_ID ) A

SELECT STD.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC STD WHERE 1=1 AND STD.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND STD.ATNDLC_CNCL_DTTM IS NULL AND STD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND STD.USER_ID IN ( -- 미평가 건수가 존재하는 유저 목록 SELECT X.USER_ID FROM ( -- 시험 및 퀴즈 관련 미평가 SELECT TK.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC AA JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON AA.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON TK.TKEXAM_ID = RSLT.TKEXAM_ID AND TK.USER_ID = RSLT.USER_ID WHERE AA.USEYN = 'Y' AND AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND RSLT.EVLYN = 'N' AND AA.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND AA.EXAM_GBNCD IN ( 'EXAM_MID', 'QUIZ_EXAM_MID', 'EXAM_MID_TEAM', 'QUIZ_SBST_EXAM_MID', -- 중간계열 'EXAM_LST', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST', 'EXAM_LST_TEAM', 'QUIZ_SBST_EXAM_LST', -- 기말계열 'EXAM', 'EXAM_TEAM', -- 일반시험ㄴ 'QUIZ', 'QUIZ_TEAM' -- 일반퀴즈 ) UNION ALL -- 과제 관련 미평가 SELECT SBM.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ASMT AA JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBM ON AA.ASMT_ID = SBM.ASMT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL ON SBM.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = EVL.ASMT_SBMSN_ID WHERE AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND EVL.EVLYN = 'N' AND AA.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND AA.ASMT_GBNCD IN ( 'MID_EXAM_SBST_ASMT', 'LST_EXAM_SBST_ASMT', 'ASMT', 'ASMT_TEAM', 'PRCTC_ASMT', 'PRCTC_ASMT_TEAM', 'INDV_ASMT' ) UNION ALL -- 토론 관련 미평가 SELECT PT.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS AA JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP PT ON AA.DSCS_ID = PT.DSCS_ID WHERE AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND PT.EVLYN = 'N' AND AA.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} UNION ALL -- 4. 설문 관련 미평가 SELECT PT.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY AA JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WK ON AA.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = WK.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PT ON AA.SRVY_ID = PT.SRVY_ID WHERE AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.USEYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND AA.SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' AND PT.SRVY_PTCP_EVLYN = 'N' AND WK.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) X GROUP BY X.USER_ID )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT STD.USER_ID) FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC STD WHERE 1=1 AND STD.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND STD.ATNDLC_CNCL_DTTM IS NULL AND STD.AUDITYN = 'N' AND STD.USER_ID IN ( -- 미평가 건수가 존재하는 유저 목록 SELECT X.USER_ID FROM ( -- 시험 및 퀴즈 관련 미평가 SELECT TK.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC AA JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON AA.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK ON DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID = TK.EXAM_DTL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RSLT ON TK.TKEXAM_ID = RSLT.TKEXAM_ID AND TK.USER_ID = RSLT.USER_ID WHERE AA.USEYN = 'Y' AND AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND RSLT.EVLYN = 'N' AND AA.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND AA.EXAM_GBNCD IN ( 'EXAM_MID', 'QUIZ_EXAM_MID', 'EXAM_MID_TEAM', 'QUIZ_SBST_EXAM_MID', -- 중간계열 'EXAM_LST', 'QUIZ_EXAM_LST', 'EXAM_LST_TEAM', 'QUIZ_SBST_EXAM_LST', -- 기말계열 'EXAM', 'EXAM_TEAM', -- 일반시험 'QUIZ', 'QUIZ_TEAM' -- 일반퀴즈 ) UNION ALL -- 과제 관련 미평가 SELECT SBM.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ASMT AA JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBM ON AA.ASMT_ID = SBM.ASMT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL ON SBM.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = EVL.ASMT_SBMSN_ID WHERE AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND EVL.EVLYN = 'N' AND AA.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND AA.ASMT_GBNCD IN ( 'MID_EXAM_SBST_ASMT', 'LST_EXAM_SBST_ASMT', 'ASMT', 'ASMT_TEAM', 'PRCTC_ASMT', 'PRCTC_ASMT_TEAM', 'INDV_ASMT' ) UNION ALL -- 토론 관련 미평가 SELECT PT.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS AA JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP PT ON AA.DSCS_ID = PT.DSCS_ID WHERE AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND PT.EVLYN = 'N' AND AA.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} UNION ALL -- 4. 설문 관련 미평가 SELECT PT.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY AA JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WK ON AA.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = WK.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PT ON AA.SRVY_ID = PT.SRVY_ID WHERE AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.USEYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND AA.SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' AND PT.SRVY_PTCP_EVLYN = 'N' AND WK.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) X GROUP BY X.USER_ID )

/* SQL ID: markSubjectDAO.invalidMrkRfltrtSumExamSelect 설 명 : 해당 과목의 시험 성적반영비율의 합이 100%인지 여부를 체크한다. */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(AA.MRK_RFLTRT, 0)) AS SUM_MRK_RFLTRT FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC AA JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ ON AA.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} WHERE 1=1 AND AA.EXAM_TYCD = 'EXAM' AND AA.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM', 'EXAM_TEAM') AND AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.USEYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' ) WHERE SUM_MRK_RFLTRT IS NULL OR SUM_MRK_RFLTRT != 100

/* SQL ID: markSubjectDAO.invalidMrkRfltrtSumQuizSelect 설 명 : 해당 과목의 퀴즈 성적반영비율의 합이 100%인지 여부를 체크한다. */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(AA.MRK_RFLTRT, 0)) AS SUM_MRK_RFLTRT FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC AA JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ ON AA.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON (SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'CHRT') WHERE 1=1 AND AA.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND AA.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ', 'QUIZ_TEAM') AND AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.USEYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' ) WHERE SUM_MRK_RFLTRT IS NULL OR SUM_MRK_RFLTRT != 100

/* SQL ID: markSubjectDAO.invalidMrkRfltrtSumAsmtSelect 설 명 : 해당 과목의 과제 성적반영비율의 합이 100%인지 여부를 체크한다. */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(AA.MRK_RFLTRT, 0)) AS SUM_MRK_RFLTRT FROM TB_LMS_ASMT AA JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ ON AA.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON (SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'CHRT') WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' ) WHERE SUM_MRK_RFLTRT IS NULL OR SUM_MRK_RFLTRT != 100

/* SQL ID: markSubjectDAO.invalidMrkRfltrtSumDscsSelect 설 명 : 해당 과목의 토론 성적반영비율의 합이 100%인지 여부를 체크한다. */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(AA.MRK_RFLTRT, 0)) AS SUM_MRK_RFLTRT FROM TB_LMS_DSCS AA JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ ON AA.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON (SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'CHRT') WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DELYN ='N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' ) WHERE SUM_MRK_RFLTRT IS NULL OR SUM_MRK_RFLTRT != 100

/* SQL ID: markSubjectDAO.invalidMrkRfltrtSumSmnrSelect 설 명 : 해당 과목의 세미나 성적반영비율의 합이 100%인지 여부를 체크한다. */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT -- SUM(NVL(AA.MRK_RFLTRT, 0)) AS SUM_MRK_RFLTRT 100 AS SUM_MRK_RFLTRT /*컬럼 변경 작업 전으로 우선 100점 처리*/ FROM TB_LMS_SMNR AA JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ ON AA.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON (SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'CHRT') WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DELYN ='N' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' ) WHERE SUM_MRK_RFLTRT IS NULL OR SUM_MRK_RFLTRT != 100

/* SQL ID: markSubjectDAO.invalidMrkRfltrtSumSrvySelect 설 명 : 해당 과목의 설문 성적반영비율의 합이 100%인지 여부를 체크한다. */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT SUM(NVL(AA.MRK_RFLTRT, 0)) AS SUM_MRK_RFLTRT FROM TB_LMS_SRVY AA JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ ON AA.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON (SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_REF_TYCD = 'CHRT') WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DELYN = 'N' AND AA.USEYN = 'Y' AND AA.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND AA.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' ) WHERE SUM_MRK_RFLTRT IS NULL OR SUM_MRK_RFLTRT != 100

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.examScoreList 설 명 : 학습자들의 일반 시험 평가점수를 조회한다. */ WITH /*-- [과목 수강생 전체와 시험 기본정보 매핑]*/ BASE_INFO_LIST AS ( SELECT B.SBJCT_ID , B.EXAM_BSC_ID , B.MRK_RFLTRT , A.USER_ID , B.EXAM_GBNCD FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B ON A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND B.EXAM_TYCD = 'EXAM' AND B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM', 'EXAM_TEAM') AND B.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND B.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.AUDITYN = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_CNCL_DTTM IS NULL ), /* -- [일반/재시험 점수 및 패널티 계산]*/ NORMAL_SCORE AS ( SELECT TK.USER_ID , DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID /*-- 미채점인경우 -1 */ , CASE WHEN RS.EVLYN = 'Y' THEN RS.TOT_SCR ELSE -1 END AS SCORE /* 재시험 패널티 여부 계산 */ , CASE WHEN (TK.RETKEXAM_YN = 'Y' AND DTL.REEXAMYN = 'Y') THEN (DTL.REEXAM_MRK_RFLTRT / 100) ELSE 1 END AS PENALTY FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RS ON TK.TKEXAM_ID = RS.TKEXAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID AND NOT EXISTS( -- 결시자 제외 (중복방지) SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABS WHERE ABS.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ABS.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ABS.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' ) ), /*--[결시자 확인 및 대체과제/시험 체크]*/ SUBSTITUTE_SCORE AS ( SELECT ABS.USER_ID , ABS.EXAM_BSC_ID AS TARGET_BSC_ID /*-- 대체 퀴즈/과제 중 점수 있는 것을 선택 AND 미채점인 경우 -1*/ , CASE WHEN (SB_QUIZ_RS.TKEXAM_ID IS NOT NULL AND SB_QUIZ_RS.EVLYN = 'N') OR (SB_ASMT_RS.ASMT_SBMSN_ID IS NOT NULL AND SB_ASMT_RS.EVLYN = 'N') THEN -1 ELSE COALESCE(SB_QUIZ_RS.TOT_SCR, SB_ASMT_RS.SCR, 0) END AS SUB_SCORE , (ABS.ABSNCE_RFLTRT / 100) AS ABS_PENALTY FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABS JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST SBST ON ABS.EXAM_BSC_ID = SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID /*-- [경로 A: 대체 퀴즈 점수 조인]*/ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL SB_QUIZ ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = SB_QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM SB_QUIZ_TK ON SB_QUIZ.EXAM_DTL_ID = SB_QUIZ_TK.EXAM_DTL_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT SB_QUIZ_RS ON SB_QUIZ_TK.TKEXAM_ID = SB_QUIZ_RS.TKEXAM_ID AND ABS.USER_ID = SB_QUIZ_RS.USER_ID /*-- [경로 B: 대체 과제 점수 조인]*/ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT SB_ASMT ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = SB_ASMT.ASMT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SB_ASMT_TK ON SB_ASMT.ASMT_ID = SB_ASMT_TK.ASMT_ID AND ABS.USER_ID = SB_ASMT_TK.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL SB_ASMT_RS ON SB_ASMT_TK.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = SB_ASMT_RS.ASMT_SBMSN_ID WHERE ABS.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' ) SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , A.USER_ID /*-- 최종 원점수(일반/재시험 점수 OR 결시 대체 점수)*/ , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 OR MIN(NVL(C.SUB_SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(B.SCORE * NVL(B.PENALTY, 1), C.SUB_SCORE * NVL(C.ABS_PENALTY, 1), 0)), 2) END AS ACQS_SCORE /*-- 성적 반영 비율 계산 최종점수 (최종 원점수 * 반영비율)*/ , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 OR MIN(NVL(C.SUB_SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(B.SCORE * NVL(B.PENALTY, 1), C.SUB_SCORE * NVL(C.ABS_PENALTY, 1), 0 ) * (A.MRK_RFLTRT / 100)), 2) END AS DRVTN_SCR FROM BASE_INFO_LIST A /*-- 일반/재시험 점수 매칭*/ LEFT JOIN NORMAL_SCORE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.EXAM_BSC_ID = B.EXAM_BSC_ID /*-- 결시 대체 점수 매칭*/ LEFT JOIN SUBSTITUTE_SCORE C ON A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND A.EXAM_BSC_ID = C.TARGET_BSC_ID GROUP BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID ORDER BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.examEvlScoreList 설 명 : 학습자들의 중간or기말고사 평가점수를 조회한다. */ WITH /*-- [과목 수강생 전체와 시험 기본정보 매핑]*/ BASE_INFO_LIST AS ( SELECT B.SBJCT_ID , NVL(C.QUIZ_BSC_ID, B.EXAM_BSC_ID) AS EXAM_BSC_ID , MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD , MRK.MRK_RFLTRT , B.MRK_RFLTRT AS SCR_RFLTRT , A.USER_ID , B.EXAM_GBNCD FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B ON A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID
AND B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_MID', 'EXAM_MID_TEAM')
AND B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_LST', 'EXAM_LST_TEAM')
AND B.EXAM_TYCD = 'EXAM' AND B.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND B.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.USEYN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_EXAMQUIZ C ON B.EXAM_BSC_ID = C.EXAM_BSC_ID -- 퀴즈형 중간/기말고사인 경우 JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG MRK ON A.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID
AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'MIDEXAM'
AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'LSTEXAM'
WHERE 1=1 AND A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.AUDITYN = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_CNCL_DTTM IS NULL ), /* 일반/재시험 점수 및 패널티 계산 */ NORMAL_SCORE AS ( SELECT TK.USER_ID , DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID , CASE WHEN RS.EVLYN = 'Y' THEN RS.TOT_SCR ELSE -1 END AS SCORE /* 미채점인경우 -1*/ , CASE WHEN (TK.RETKEXAM_YN = 'Y' AND DTL.REEXAMYN = 'Y') THEN (DTL.REEXAM_MRK_RFLTRT / 100) ELSE 1 END AS PENALTY FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RS ON TK.TKEXAM_ID = RS.TKEXAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID AND NOT EXISTS( -- 결시자 제외 (중복방지) SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABS WHERE ABS.EXAM_BSC_ID = DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ABS.USER_ID = TK.USER_ID AND ABS.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' ) ), /* 결시자 확인 및 대체과제/시험 체크 */ SUBSTITUTE_SCORE AS ( SELECT ABS.USER_ID , ABS.EXAM_BSC_ID AS TARGET_BSC_ID /* 대체 퀴즈/과제 중 점수 있는 것을 선택 AND 미채점인 경우 -1*/ , CASE WHEN (SB_QUIZ_RS.TKEXAM_ID IS NOT NULL AND SB_QUIZ_RS.EVLYN = 'N') OR (SB_ASMT_RS.ASMT_SBMSN_ID IS NOT NULL AND SB_ASMT_RS.EVLYN = 'N') THEN -1 ELSE COALESCE(SB_QUIZ_RS.TOT_SCR, SB_ASMT_RS.SCR, 0) END AS SUB_SCORE , (ABS.ABSNCE_RFLTRT / 100) AS ABS_PENALTY FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_ABSNCE ABS JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_EVL_SBST SBST ON ABS.EXAM_BSC_ID = SBST.EXAM_BSC_ID /* [경로 A: 대체 퀴즈 점수 조인] */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL SB_QUIZ ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = SB_QUIZ.EXAM_BSC_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM SB_QUIZ_TK ON SB_QUIZ.EXAM_DTL_ID = SB_QUIZ_TK.EXAM_DTL_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT SB_QUIZ_RS ON SB_QUIZ_TK.TKEXAM_ID = SB_QUIZ_RS.TKEXAM_ID AND ABS.USER_ID = SB_QUIZ_RS.USER_ID /* [경로 B: 대체 과제 점수 조인] */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT SB_ASMT ON SBST.EXAM_SBST_ID = SB_ASMT.ASMT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SB_ASMT_TK ON SB_ASMT.ASMT_ID = SB_ASMT_TK.ASMT_ID AND ABS.USER_ID = SB_ASMT_TK.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL SB_ASMT_RS ON SB_ASMT_TK.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = SB_ASMT_RS.ASMT_SBMSN_ID WHERE ABS.ABSNCE_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV' ) SELECT A.USER_ID
, 'MIDEXAM' AS MRK_ITM_TYCD
, 'LSTEXAM' AS MRK_ITM_TYCD
, 'EXAM' AS MRK_ITM_TYCD
/* 최종 산출점수(일반/재시험 점수 OR 결시 대체 점수)*/ , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 OR MIN(NVL(C.SUB_SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM( COALESCE(B.SCORE * NVL(B.PENALTY, 1), C.SUB_SCORE * NVL(C.ABS_PENALTY, 1), 0) * A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100 ), 2) END AS ACQS_SCR /* 성적 반영 비율 계산 최종점수 (최종 원점수 * 반영비율)*/ , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 OR MIN(NVL(C.SUB_SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM( COALESCE(B.SCORE * NVL(B.PENALTY, 1), C.SUB_SCORE * NVL(C.ABS_PENALTY, 1), 0 ) * A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100 ) * A.MRK_RFLTRT / 100, 2) END AS DRVTN_SCR FROM BASE_INFO_LIST A /* 일반/재시험 점수 매칭 */ LEFT JOIN NORMAL_SCORE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.EXAM_BSC_ID = B.EXAM_BSC_ID /* 결시 대체 점수 매칭*/ LEFT JOIN SUBSTITUTE_SCORE C ON A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND A.EXAM_BSC_ID = C.TARGET_BSC_ID GROUP BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID, A.MRK_ITM_TYCD, A.MRK_RFLTRT ORDER BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID
/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.stdMrkSbjctList 설 명 : 해당 과목에 수강하는 사용자 아이디를 가져온다. */ SELECT USER_ID , SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATNDLC_CNCL_DTTM IS NULL AND AUDITYN = 'N'

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.stdAttdSummaryByWeekSelect 설 명 : 해당 과목 강의 컨텐츠가 있는 주차 수, 학생이 수강완료한 주차 수, 자각한 주차 수를 조회한다.. */ WITH STD_INFO AS ( /*학생*/ SELECT A.USER_ID , A.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A JOIN TB_LMS_USER B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'ATNDLC' ), LESSON_CONTS AS ( /*강의컨텐츠가 있는 주차 정보*/ SELECT WK.SBJCT_ID , WK.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , WK.LCTR_WKNO_SEQNO FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WK WHERE WK.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND WK.DELYN = 'N' AND ( WK.LCTR_TYCD = 'LCTR' /*강의 컨텐츠*/ OR EXISTS ( /*비디오컨텐츠*/ SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR LC JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS CON ON LC.LCTR_ID = CON.LCTR_ID WHERE LC.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = WK.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND ( CON.LCTR_CONTS_TYCD = 'VDO' OR CON.CONTS_URL IS NOT NULL) ) ) ORDER BY LCTR_WKNO_SEQNO ASC ) /*강의컨텐츠가 있는 주차 수, 완료한 주차 수, 지각한 주차 수*/ SELECT A.USER_ID , COUNT(A.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID) AS LCTR_SCHDL_CNT , NVL( SUM(CASE WHEN A.LRN_STSCD = 'CMPTN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) , 0)AS COMPLETE_CNT , NVL( SUM(CASE WHEN A.LRN_STSCD = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) , 0)AS LATE_CNT FROM ( /*주별 학습자 학습상태*/ SELECT STD.USER_ID , CON.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , CON.LCTR_WKNO_SEQNO , STS.LRN_STSCD FROM STD_INFO STD CROSS JOIN LESSON_CONTS CON LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_BYWKNO_USER_LRN_STS STS ON STD.USER_ID = STS.USER_ID AND CON.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = STS.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID ) A GROUP BY A.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.prgScoreList 설 명 : 학습자들의 진도 점수를 조회한다. */ WITH SBJ_LIST AS( SELECT SMSTR.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , SBJ.DEPT_ID , DEPT.DEPTNM , SBJ.SBJCT_YR , SBJ.SBJCT_SMSTR , SBJ.SBJCT_ID , SBJ.SBJCTNM , SBJ.DVCLAS_NO , MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD , MRK.MRK_RFLTRT , NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL X WHERE X.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID GROUP BY X.SBJCT_ID) , 0) AS OPEN_WK_CNT FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON SBJ.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON SBJ.DEPT_ID = DEPT.DEPT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON DEPT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID AND ORG.USEYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG MRK ON SBJ.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'PRG' WHERE 1=1 AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND SBJ.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJ.USEYN = 'Y' ), OPEN_WK_LIST AS ( SELECT SBJ.*, WK.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID FROM SBJ_LIST SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WK ON SBJ.SBJCT_ID = WK.SBJCT_ID AND WK.DELYN = 'N' ) SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , STD.USER_ID , A.MRK_ITM_TYCD , ROUND( NVL(SUM(STS.PRGRT) ,0) / A.OPEN_WK_CNT , 2) AS ACQS_SCR , ROUND( NVL(SUM(STS.PRGRT) ,0) / A.OPEN_WK_CNT * (A.MRK_RFLTRT / 100) , 2) AS DRVTN_SCR FROM OPEN_WK_LIST A JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC STD ON A.SBJCT_ID = STD.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_BYWKNO_USER_LRN_STS STS ON A.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = STS.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND STD.USER_ID = STS.USER_ID GROUP BY A.SBJCT_ID, STD.USER_ID, A.OPEN_WK_CNT, A.MRK_ITM_TYCD, A.MRK_RFLTRT

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.exrcsQstnScoreList 설 명 : 학습자들의 연습문제 취득점수를 조회한다. */ WITH SBJ_LIST AS( SELECT SBJ.SBJCT_ID , MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD , MRK.MRK_RFLTRT FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG MRK ON SBJ.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'EXRCS_QSTN' WHERE SBJ.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJ.USEYN = 'Y' ) SELECT SBJ.SBJCT_ID , STD.USER_ID , SBJ.MRK_ITM_TYCD , 100 AS ACQS_SCR , ROUND( 100 * (SBJ.MRK_RFLTRT / 100) ,2) AS DRVTN_SCR FROM SBJ_LIST SBJ JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC STD ON SBJ.SBJCT_ID = STD.SBJCT_ID AND STD.AUDITYN = 'N' WHERE SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.smnrEvlScoreList 설 명 : 학습자들의 세미나 평가점수를 조회한다. */ SELECT SBJ.SBJCT_ID , STD.USER_ID , MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD , 100 AS ACQS_SCR /* 세미나 작업 전이라 임시로 100점 넣어둠 */ , 100 * (MRK.MRK_RFLTRT / 100) AS DRVTN_SCR /*FROM TB_LMS_SMNR SMNR*/ FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC SMNR JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJ ON SMNR.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND SBJ.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC STD ON SBJ.SBJCT_ID = STD.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG MRK ON MRK.SBJCT_ID = SBJ.SBJCT_ID AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'SMNR' WHERE 1=1 /* AND SMNR.DELYN = 'N' AND SMNR.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND SMNR.MRK_RFLTRT > 0*/ GROUP BY SBJ.SBJCT_ID, STD.USER_ID, MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD, MRK.MRK_RFLTRT ORDER BY SBJ.SBJCT_ID, STD.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.asmtEvlScoreList 설 명 : 학습자들의 과제 평가점수를 조회한다. */ WITH /* 과목 수강생 + 기준과제(부모)정보 */ BASE_INFO_LIST AS ( SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , B.ASMT_ID AS BASE_ASMT_ID /*기준 과제 ID*/ , A.USER_ID , B.MRK_RFLTRT AS SCR_RFLTRT/*점수 반영비율*/ , MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD , MRK.MRK_RFLTRT FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT B ON A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL /*최상위 과제만 선택*/ AND B.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND B.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND B.ASMT_GBNCD IN ('ASMT', 'ASMT_TEAM', 'PRCTC_ASMT', 'PRCTC_ASMT_TEAM') AND B.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG MRK ON A.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'ASMT' ), /* 과제 제출 및 평가점수 추출(최신건 기준) */ ASMT_SCORE AS ( SELECT ASMT.SBJCT_ID /*팀과제면 부모 ID, 개인과제면 자기자신ID를 기준ID로 설정*/ , NVL(ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID, ASMT.ASMT_ID) AS BASE_ASMT_ID , SBM.USER_ID , CASE WHEN EVL.EVLYN = 'Y' THEN EVL.SCR ELSE -1 END AS SCORE /* 팀과제의 경우 부모ID에서 재시험반영비율 가져옴 */ , CASE WHEN SBM.SBMSN_CNT > 1 THEN ( CASE WHEN ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL THEN (ASMT.RESBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT / 100) ELSE (NVL(UP.RESBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT, ASMT.RESBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT) / 100) END ) ELSE 1 END AS PENALTY FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY A.ASMT_ID, A.USER_ID ORDER BY A.REG_DTTM DESC) AS RN , A.ASMT_ID , A.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , A.USER_ID , A.SBMSN_CNT FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN A ) SBM JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT ON SBM.ASMT_ID = ASMT.ASMT_ID /*부모 정보 조인용*/ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT UP ON ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID = UP.ASMT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL ON SBM.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = EVL.ASMT_SBMSN_ID WHERE SBM.RN = 1 ) SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , A.USER_ID , A.MRK_ITM_TYCD /*-- 하나라도 미채점(-1)이 있으면 전체 -1, 아니면 합산*/ , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE,0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND( SUM(NVL(B.SCORE, 0) * NVL(B.PENALTY, 1) * A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100), 2) END AS ACQS_SCR /* 반영비율이 계산된 최종 점수*/ , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND( SUM(NVL(B.SCORE, 0) * NVL(B.PENALTY, 1) * (A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100)) * A.MRK_RFLTRT / 100, 2) END AS DRVTN_SCR FROM BASE_INFO_LIST A LEFT JOIN ASMT_SCORE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.BASE_ASMT_ID = B.BASE_ASMT_ID GROUP BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID, A.MRK_ITM_TYCD, A.MRK_RFLTRT ORDER BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.dscsEvlScoreList 설 명 : 학습자들의 토론 평가점수를 조회한다. */ WITH BASE_INFO_LIST AS ( SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , B.DSCS_ID AS BASE_DSCS_ID /*기준 토론 ID*/ , MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD , MRK.MRK_RFLTRT , B.MRK_RFLTRT AS SCR_RFLTRT , A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS B ON A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.UP_DSCS_ID IS NULL /*최상위 토론만 선택*/ AND B.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND B.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND B.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG MRK ON A.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'DSCS' ), DSCS_SCORE AS ( SELECT DSCS.DSCS_ID /*팀토론이면 부모ID, 일반토론이면 자기자신ID를 기준ID로 설정*/ , NVL(DSCS.UP_DSCS_ID, DSCS.DSCS_ID) AS BASE_DSCS_ID , PTCT.USER_ID , CASE WHEN PTCT.EVLYN = 'Y' THEN PTCT.SCR ELSE -1 END AS SCORE FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP PTCT JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS DSCS ON PTCT.DSCS_ID = DSCS.DSCS_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS UP ON DSCS.UP_DSCS_ID = UP.DSCS_ID ) SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , A.USER_ID , A.MRK_ITM_TYCD , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(NVL(B.SCORE, 0) * A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100), 2) END AS ACQS_SCR , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(NVL(B.SCORE, 0) * A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100 ) * A.MRK_RFLTRT / 100, 2) END AS DRVTN_SCR FROM BASE_INFO_LIST A LEFT JOIN DSCS_SCORE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.BASE_DSCS_ID = B.BASE_DSCS_ID GROUP BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID, A.MRK_ITM_TYCD, A.MRK_RFLTRT ORDER BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.quizEvlScoreList 설 명 : 학습자들의 퀴즈 평가점수를 조회한다. */ WITH BASE_INFO_LIST AS ( SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , B.EXAM_BSC_ID , MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD , MRK.MRK_RFLTRT , A.USER_ID , B.MRK_RFLTRT AS SCR_RFLTRT FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B ON A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('QUIZ', 'QUIZ_TEAM') AND B.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND B.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.USEYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG MRK ON A.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' ), QUIZ_SCORE AS ( SELECT TK.USER_ID , DTL.EXAM_BSC_ID /*미채점인 경우 -1*/ , CASE WHEN RS.EVLYN = 'Y' THEN RS.TOT_SCR ELSE -1 END AS SCORE , CASE WHEN (TK.RETKEXAM_YN = 'Y' AND DTL.REEXAMYN = 'Y') THEN (DTL.REEXAM_MRK_RFLTRT / 100) ELSE 1 END AS PENALTY FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM TK JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT RS ON TK.TKEXAM_ID = RS.TKEXAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL DTL ON TK.EXAM_DTL_ID = DTL.EXAM_DTL_ID ) SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , A.USER_ID , A.MRK_ITM_TYCD /*최종 원점수(일반/재시험 점수)*/ , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM( NVL(B.SCORE,0) * NVL(B.PENALTY, 1) * (A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100) ), 2) END AS ACQS_SCR /* 성적반영비율 계산 최종점수 */ , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(NVL(B.SCORE,0) * NVL(B.PENALTY, 1) * (A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100)) * (A.MRK_RFLTRT / 100), 2) END AS DRVTN_SCR FROM BASE_INFO_LIST A LEFT JOIN QUIZ_SCORE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.EXAM_BSC_ID = B.EXAM_BSC_ID GROUP BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID, A.MRK_ITM_TYCD, A.MRK_RFLTRT ORDER BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.srvyScoreEvlList 설 명 : 학습자들의 설문 평가점수를 조회한다. */ WITH BASE_INFO_LIST AS ( SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , B.SRVY_ID AS BASE_SRVY_ID , MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD , MRK.MRK_RFLTRT , B.MRK_RFLTRT AS SCR_RFLTRT , A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY B ON A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND B.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL /*최상위 설문만 선택*/ AND B.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND B.MRK_RFLTRT > 0 AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.USEYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_MRK_ITM_STNG MRK ON A.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID AND MRK.MRK_ITM_TYCD = 'SRVY' WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ), SRVY_SCORE AS ( SELECT SRVY.SRVY_ID /*팀설문이면 부모ID, 일반설문이면 자기자신ID를 기준ID로 설정*/ , NVL(SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID, SRVY.SRVY_ID ) AS BASE_SRVY_ID , PTCP.USER_ID , CASE WHEN PTCP.SRVY_PTCP_EVLYN = 'Y' THEN PTCP.PTCP_EVL_SCR ELSE -1 END AS SCORE FROM TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PTCP JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY ON PTCP.SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY UP ON SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID = UP.SRVY_ID ) SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , A.USER_ID , A.MRK_ITM_TYCD , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(NVL(B.SCORE, 0) * A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100), 2) END AS ACQS_SCR , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(B.SCORE, 0)) = -1 THEN -1 ELSE ROUND(SUM(NVL(B.SCORE, 0) * A.SCR_RFLTRT / 100) * (A.MRK_RFLTRT / 100), 2) END AS DRVTN_SCR FROM BASE_INFO_LIST A LEFT JOIN SRVY_SCORE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.BASE_SRVY_ID = B.BASE_SRVY_ID GROUP BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID, A.MRK_ITM_TYCD, A.MRK_RFLTRT ORDER BY A.SBJCT_ID, A.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.adtnScoreList 설 명 : 학생들의 가산점을 조회한다. (이의신청 승인 후 얻은 점수) */ SELECT USER_ID , OBJCT_APLY_SCR AS ADTN_SCR FROM TB_LMS_MRK_OBJCT_APLY WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND OBJCT_APLY_STSCD = 'APRV'
mapper.update:
/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.mrkSbjctBatchUpdate 설 명 : 학생들의 성적과목 데이터를 업데이트한다. */
UPDATE TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK SET TOT_SCR = #{item.totScr}, LST_SCR = #{item.lstScr}, ADTN_SCR = #{item.adtnScr}, ETC_SCR = #{item.etcScr}, MDFR_ID = #{item.mdfrId}, MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{item.sbjctId} AND USER_ID = #{item.userId} AND SBJCT_MRK_ID = #{item.sbjctMrkId}

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.mrkSbjctDtlBatchUpdate 설 명 : 학생들의 성적과목상세 데이터를 업데이트한다. */
UPDATE TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK_DTL SET ACQS_SCR = #{item.acqsScr}, DRVTN_SCR = #{item.drvtnScr}, MDFR_ID = #{item.mdfrId}, MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE SBJCT_MRK_ID = #{item.sbjctMrkId} AND MRK_ITM_TYCD = #{item.mrkItmTycd}

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.scrCnvsStsModify 설 명 : 학생들의 점수환산상태를 업데이트한다. */ UPDATE TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK SET SCR_CNVS_STSCD = #{scrCnvsStscd}, MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId}, MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.AvgScrInfoByMrkItmSelect 설 명 : 해당 과목의 성적항목별 평균점수를 조회한다. */ SELECT DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD , ROUND(AVG(DTL.DRVTN_SCR), 2) AS AVG_SCR FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC STD JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK MRK ON STD.SBJCT_ID = MRK.SBJCT_ID AND STD.USER_ID = MRK.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK_DTL DTL ON MRK.SBJCT_MRK_ID = DTL.SBJCT_MRK_ID WHERE STD.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} GROUP BY DTL.MRK_ITM_TYCD

/* SQL ID : markSubjectDAO.mrkRangeStatusSelect 설 명 : 해당 과목의 점수 구간별 인원 수를 조회한다. */ SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN MRK.LST_SCR BETWEEN 0 AND 50 THEN 1 END),0) AS SCORE50 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN MRK.LST_SCR BETWEEN 51 AND 60 THEN 1 END),0) AS SCORE60 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN MRK.LST_SCR BETWEEN 61 AND 70 THEN 1 END),0) AS SCORE70 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN MRK.LST_SCR BETWEEN 71 AND 80 THEN 1 END),0) AS SCORE80 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN MRK.LST_SCR BETWEEN 81 AND 90 THEN 1 END),0) AS SCORE90 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN MRK.LST_SCR BETWEEN 91 AND 100 THEN 1 END),0) AS SCORE100 , NVL(COUNT(1),0) AS STD_COUNT FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_MRK MRK WHERE MRK.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}
